Big win for The Luxora Collective this week 🙌

We’re officially hitting that inflection point… ads are dialed, sales calls are coming in hot, and we’re onboarding new clients consistently to the point where we’re now looking to expand the team.

Huge thank you to Limitless, Gil, and the entire team for your patience while we built this the right way. We didn’t rush it, we focused on getting the foundation solid first… and now it’s starting to compound.

Excited for what’s ahead. This is just the beginning 🚀
